meta.author: Acharya Rama Daivagya
meta.title: Classical provenance registry for the astro-cal muhurta engine
meta.principle: No fabricated citations. Every verse entry is either 'confirmed' (Sanskrit verified against Muhurta Chintamani text) or 'unverified' (classical concept whose exact sloka still needs verification against muhurtha-chinthamani.pdf) or 'formula' (pure panchanga arithmetic — cite vedic_panchang.pdf, no sloka).

variants.issue: Printed English editions (and the OCR archive in reference/archive/250_rule_muhurta_engine) read 'Aquarius, Pisces, Cancer, Leo' for Mrityu Loka, an Aquarius<->Libra translation swap.
variants.resolved_as: Cancer, Leo, Libra, Pisces (Sloka 46: karkisimhatulamine mrityuloke tu bhadrika). Engine uses [3,4,6,11] (engine.js:516).

panchanga.name: Panchanga Tables / Appendices
panchanga.title: Panchanga tables (Rahu Kalam, Yama Ghanta, Gulika, Sankranti)

BHADRA_EARTH_ACTIVE.label: Bhadra (Vishti) in Mrityu Loka
BHADRA_EARTH_ACTIVE.sanskrit_sloka:
संसर्पिणी तु सिंहस्थे मेषे गोयुग्मके स्थिता।
मृत्युलोके यदा भद्रा तदा शुभविनाशिनी॥

कर्किसिंहतुलामीने मृत्युलोके तु भद्रिका॥
BHADRA_EARTH_ACTIVE.english_translation: When Bhadra resides in Mrityu Loka — Moon in Karka (Cancer), Simha (Leo), Tula (Libra), or Meena (Pisces) — she destroys all auspicious works. Puchha (tail) phases are exempt.
BHADRA_EARTH_ACTIVE.applied_rule_logic: Hard T1 block when active Vishti Karana with Moon in a Mrityu Loka rashi [3,4,6,11], bypassed only in Puchha (Sloka 47).

SARVARTHA_SIDDHI_YOGA.label: Sarvartha Siddhi Yoga neutralizer
SARVARTHA_SIDDHI_YOGA.sanskrit_sloka:
सिद्धियोगेषु सर्वेषु दुष्टा अपि गुणावहाः।
कुयोगान्नाशयन्त्याशु सूर्यस्येव तमोगणाः॥
SARVARTHA_SIDDHI_YOGA.english_translation: Among all Siddhi yogas even malefic combinations become favorable; like the sun dispelling darkness, they instantly neutralize the inauspicious yogas.
SARVARTHA_SIDDHI_YOGA.applied_rule_logic: Active Sarvartha Siddhi cancels T2/T3 penalities (Dagdha/Masa Shunya) and may add bonus; never rescues a T1 hard blocker.

ASTA_GURU_ACTIVE.label: Jupiter combust (Asta Guru)
ASTA_GURU_ACTIVE.sanskrit_sloka:
शुक्रास्तगुरुमौढ्येषु बाल्यवार्धकयोस्तथा।
न कुर्याद् गृहप्रवेशं च सर्वमङ्गलकर्मसु॥
ASTA_GURU_ACTIVE.english_translation: New residential entry (Griha Pravesha) and all auspicious works must not be undertaken during the combustion (Asta), infancy (Balya), or senility (Vardhakya) of Venus or Jupiter.
ASTA_GURU_ACTIVE.applied_rule_logic: Hard T1 blocker for Griha Pravesha-class activities when Jupiter's solar elongation <= 11 deg.

ASTA_SHUKRA_ACTIVE.label: Venus combust (Asta Shukra)
ASTA_SHUKRA_ACTIVE.sanskrit_sloka:
शुक्रास्तगुरुमौढ्येषु बाल्यवार्धकयोस्तथा।
न कुर्याद् गृहप्रवेशं च सर्वमङ्गलकर्मसु॥
ASTA_SHUKRA_ACTIVE.english_translation: New residential entry (Griha Pravesha) and all auspicious works must not be undertaken during the combustion (Asta), infancy (Balya), or senility (Vardhakya) of Venus or Jupiter.
ASTA_SHUKRA_ACTIVE.applied_rule_logic: Hard T1 blocker for Griha Pravesha-class activities when Venus's solar elongation <= 8 deg.

TUESDAY_ACTIVE.label: Tuesday borrow ban (Bhauma Vara)
TUESDAY_ACTIVE.sanskrit_sloka:
भौमवारे ऋणं दद्यान्न तु ग्राह्यं कदाचन।
ग्राह्यं यदा तदा वृद्धिर्दाता मुच्येत नान्यथा॥
TUESDAY_ACTIVE.english_translation: Repay debt on Tuesday to be freed; never borrow on Tuesday, for the debt then multiplies (and only the creditor is released).
TUESDAY_ACTIVE.applied_rule_logic: Hard T1 block on Tuesday (vara 2) for loan/mortgage-class activities; repay-debt activities use Tuesday as a preference.

MARS_HORA_ACTIVE.label: Mars Hora (hostile terms window)
MARS_HORA_ACTIVE.sanskrit_sloka:
मित्रमृदुक्षिप्रभैश्च नृपाणां सन्धिकल्पसम्।
कुर्यात् संग्रामकार्याणि क्रूरोग्रैस्तु विचारयेत्॥
MARS_HORA_ACTIVE.english_translation: Treaties, alliances, and commercial accords must be concluded under Mridu and Kshipra nakshatras; aggressive/conflict operations are reserved for the Ugra class.
MARS_HORA_ACTIVE.applied_rule_logic: Mars Hora is blocked for contract/alliance-class activities; exact Mars-Hora sloka to be verified against muhurtha-chinthamani.pdf.

DISHA_SHOOLA_ACTIVE.label: Disha Shoola (directional prohibition)
DISHA_SHOOLA_ACTIVE.sanskrit_sloka:
इन्दुअर्कयोः प्राचीं न यायात् शुक्रेऽर्के पश्चिमां तथा।
भौमज्ञयोरुदीचीं च गुरौ याम्यां विवर्जयेत्॥
DISHA_SHOOLA_ACTIVE.english_translation: Do not travel east on Moon/Sun days, west on Venus/Sun days, north on Mars/Mercury days, or south on Jupiter days.
DISHA_SHOOLA_ACTIVE.applied_rule_logic: Hard T1 block when the activity's required direction conflicts with the travel-day ruler (Disha Shoola matrix).

EIGHTH_HOUSE_OCCUPIED.label: 8th house (Randhra) occupied by malefics
EIGHTH_HOUSE_OCCUPIED.sanskrit_sloka:
उग्रैस्तीक्ष्णैश्च नक्षत्रैः शस्त्रघातप्रणाशनम्।
छिन्दन्त्याशु व्यथां नृणां रन्ध्रहीने च लग्नके॥
EIGHTH_HOUSE_OCCUPIED.english_translation: Surgical excision is accomplished quickly under Ugra/Tikshna nakshatras when the 8th house (Randhra) from the muhurta lagna is unoccupied.
EIGHTH_HOUSE_OCCUPIED.applied_rule_logic: Hard T1 blocker for surgical-class activities when the 8th house from the muhurta chart carries a malefic. Requires full chart (v1: transit signal).

TITHI_GROUP.label: Tithi group / Rikta avoidance
TITHI_GROUP.sanskrit_sloka:
स्थिरमृदुक्षिप्रचरेषु वास्तुपूजां समाचरेत्।
रिक्तां पञ्चदशीं हित्वा शुभाः स्युः सर्वतिथयः॥
TITHI_GROUP.english_translation: Perform Vastu Puja under Sthira, Mridu, or Kshipra nakshatras, avoiding Rikta tithis and the fifteenth (Amavasya); all other tithis are auspicious.
TITHI_GROUP.applied_rule_logic: Basis for tithi-group fit (Nanda/Bhadra/Jaya/Rikta/Poorna) and the bad-tithi Rikta blocker. Group deity taxonomy per Chapter 1, Slokas 3-5 (unverified).

NAKSHATRA_GROUP.label: Sevenfold nakshatra functional classification
NAKSHATRA_GROUP.applied_rule_logic: Basis for Sthira/Chara/Mridu/Kshipra/Tikshna functional-group mapping of every corpus activity. Exact sloka verses to be verified against muhurtha-chinthamani.pdf.

VISHTI_KARANA.label: Vishti Karana schedule
VISHTI_KARANA.applied_rule_logic: Basis for the Vishti/Bhadra active-tithi and half schedule (badKaranas=[6]); derived from the Bhadra matrix in classical_rule_architecture_mc.md §5.

VYATIPATA_YOGA_ACTIVE.label: Vyatipata Nitya Yoga (full ghati ban)
VYATIPATA_YOGA_ACTIVE.applied_rule_logic: Full-span prohibition when Nitya Yoga = Vyatipata (index 16). Yoga enumeration per Chapter 1, Slokas 28-29 (unverified).

VAIDHRITI_YOGA_ACTIVE.label: Vaidhriti Nitya Yoga (full ghati ban)
VAIDHRITI_YOGA_ACTIVE.applied_rule_logic: Full-span prohibition when Nitya Yoga = Vaidhriti (index 26). Yoga enumeration per Chapter 1, Slokas 28-29 (unverified).

RAHU_KALAM_ACTIVE.label: Rahu Kalam
RAHU_KALAM_ACTIVE.applied_rule_logic: Sub-day inauspicious period of the ascendant/constellation ruler; used for booked-moment T1 (PRD §2.5). Table-based, cite vedic_panchang.pdf.

YAMA_GHANTA_ACTIVE.label: Yama Ghanta
YAMA_GHANTA_ACTIVE.applied_rule_logic: Sub-day inauspicious window; day-granular engine cannot score it (dropped at corpus load). Table-based, cite vedic_panchang.pdf.

GULIKA_KALAM_ACTIVE.label: Gulika Kalam
GULIKA_KALAM_ACTIVE.applied_rule_logic: Sub-day inauspicious period of the malefic fraction; used as an override neutralizer. Table-based, cite vedic_panchang.pdf.

SANKRANTI_DAY_ACTIVE.label: Sankranti day
SANKRANTI_DAY_ACTIVE.applied_rule_logic: Hard T1 block on solar-ingress day (tDay===1) for auspicious starts. Table-based, cite vedic_panchang.pdf.

ABHIJIT_MUHURTA.label: Abhijit Muhurta override
ABHIJIT_MUHURTA.applied_rule_logic: 48-min window about solar noon rescues only weak daily temporal afflictions (weak Vara/Rahu/Gulika); never T1 hard blockers (debugging-tips §1/§2).

AMRITA_SIDDHI_YOGA.label: Amrita Siddhi Yoga neutralizer
AMRITA_SIDDHI_YOGA.applied_rule_logic: Siddhi-yoga family neutralizer (same classical class as Sarvartha); exact Amrita sloka to be verified.

RAVI_YOGA.label: Ravi (Sun) Yoga neutralizer
RAVI_YOGA.applied_rule_logic: Sun-derived auspicious yoga used as an override neutralizer. Verse reference to be verified.

MARS_EXALTED_OR_IN_OWN_SIGN.label: Mars exalted / own-sign overrides
MARS_EXALTED_OR_IN_OWN_SIGN.applied_rule_logic: Planetary-functional-strength neutralizer; derives from the nakshatra/planet chapter. Verse reference to be verified.

KSHAYA_TITHI_ACTIVE.label: Kshaya Tithi
KSHAYA_TITHI_ACTIVE.applied_rule_logic: Dropped tithi due to lunar-velocity compression on the day; treated as an affliction. Table-based.

WANING_MOON_EXTREME.label: Extreme waning moon
WANING_MOON_EXTREME.applied_rule_logic: Amavasya/krishna-paksha floor for growth activities. Moon-phase arithmetic, cite vedic_panchang.pdf.

AFFLICTED_MOON_WATER_SIGN.label: Moon afflicted in a water sign
AFFLICTED_MOON_WATER_SIGN.applied_rule_logic: Moon-in-water-sign affliction flag for liquid/flow activities; transit signal, no classical sloka.

MOON_TRANSIT_BODY_PART_SIGN.label: Moon transit through body-part sign
MOON_TRANSIT_BODY_PART_SIGN.applied_rule_logic: Body-part corpus concept (e.g., head/limb rashi) used for medical topicality; modern mapping, no classical sloka.

LATTA_DOSHA_ACTIVE.label: Latta Dosha (planetary kick on marriage nakshatra)
LATTA_DOSHA_ACTIVE.english_translation: Mercury, Rahu, Full Moon and Venus hit (kick) the nakshatras that are respectively (counted backwards) the 7th, 9th, 22nd and 5th from the nakshatra in which these planets are situated. Sun, Saturn, Jupiter and Mars hit the nakshatras that are respectively (in regular order) the 12th, 8th, 6th and 3rd from their nakshatra. The nakshatra subjected to Latta Dosha is rejected for the marriage samskara. Effects: Sun-loss of money; Moon-total destruction; Mars-death; Mercury-destruction; Jupiter-destruction of relatives; Venus-loss of work; Saturn-destruction of the family; Rahu-death.
LATTA_DOSHA_ACTIVE.applied_rule_logic: Hard marriage blocker when the proposed marriage nakshatra equals a transiting planet's kicked nakshatra (Rahu counts backward despite retrograde; the 9th nakshatra in regular order from Rahu's star is the Latta star).

VASTU_SUAPTA_PERIOD.label: Vastu Suapta (Vastu sleeps) period
VASTU_SUAPTA_PERIOD.applied_rule_logic: Periods when the site/Vastu is considered dormant; prohibited for groundbreaking-class activities. Verse reference to be verified.

TARA.label: Tara Bala (janma-nakshatra compatibility)
TARA.applied_rule_logic: Personal-mode pierce: tara number/nature vs the native's janma nakshatra. Table-based, cite vedic_panchang.pdf.

FORMULA_PANCHANGA.label: Panchanga arithmetic (tithi/nakshatra/karana/yoga/vara)
FORMULA_PANCHANGA.applied_rule_logic: Base scoring terms and panchanga fit derived from sidereal-last equations; formulas per vedic_panchang.pdf.

VIVAHA_MELAPAKA_36_GUNA.label: Eight Kootas / 36 Guna Melapaka
VIVAHA_MELAPAKA_36_GUNA.english_translation: The eight Kootas in the Melapaka of marriage: 1. Varna, 2. Vashya, 3. Tara, 4. Yoni, 5. Grahamaitri, 6. Ganamaitri, 7. Bhakoota, 8. Nadi. Each has one or more guna than the former: Varna 1, Vashya 2, Tara 3, Yoni 4, Grahamaitri 5, Ganamaitri 6, Bhakoota 7, Nadi 8. By the rule of 'Saika Padaghana Padardhama' the total is (8+1)x8/2 = 36 gunas.
VIVAHA_MELAPAKA_36_GUNA.applied_rule_logic: Stage-1 matchmaking basis: compute all 8 kootas summing to 36; breakdown shape used by the Ashtakoota engine.

VIVAHA_THRESHOLD_18.label: Eligibility threshold (18/36) and quality tiers
VIVAHA_THRESHOLD_18.english_translation: If the total gunas of Melapaka of the bridegroom and the bride is 18 or more, the Nakshatra Melapaka is suitable for marriage. The greater the gunas than 18, the better. Per 'Jyotirnibandha': 16 gunas is not suitable; 17-20 medium; 21-31 excellent; 31-36 most excellent. But if there is the 'Dusta Bhakoota' (evil Bhakoota), it is inauspicious up to 20, medium 21-25, excellent 26-30, most excellent 30-36.
VIVAHA_THRESHOLD_18.applied_rule_logic: Stage-1 gate: isCompatible = totalScore >= 18 AND no uncanceled Nadi/Bhakoot dosha; tier labels derived from the Jyotirnibandha scale.

VIVAHA_VARNA_KOOTA.label: Varna Koota (1 point)
VIVAHA_VARNA_KOOTA.english_translation: Pisces, Scorpio and Cancer are Brahmin; Aries, Leo and Sagittarius are Kshatriya; Taurus, Virgo and Capricorn are Vaishya; Gemini, Aquarius and Libra are Shudra. A girl of higher Varna than the boy is not auspicious. If the bridegroom's Varna is higher than or different from the bride's, one guna is obtained; otherwise zero.
VIVAHA_VARNA_KOOTA.applied_rule_logic: calcVarna: score = groomVarna >= brideVarna ? 1 : 0 using the RASHI_VARNA table.

VIVAHA_VASHYA_KOOTA.label: Vashya Koota (2 points)
VIVAHA_VASHYA_KOOTA.english_translation: Vashya means attraction; there are three kinds of Vashya - Sakhya/Maitra (friendship), Bair (enmity) and Bhakshya (that which digests). If both have Maitri as Vashya there are 2 gunas; if Bair and Bhakshya, zero; if Vashya and Bair, 1; if Vashya and Bhakshya, 1/2. The four Vashyas: Chatushpada (quadruped), Nara (male), Jalachara (water), Banachara (forest), Keeta (insect).
VIVAHA_VASHYA_KOOTA.applied_rule_logic: calcVashya via the Vashya speculum of signs; friendship/enmity from the Vashya point table.

VIVAHA_TARA_KOOTA.label: Tara Koota (3 points)
VIVAHA_TARA_KOOTA.english_translation: Count from the girl's nakshatra to the boy's, then from the boy's to the girl's. If dividing each count by 9 leaves remainder 3/5/7, that Tara is inauspicious; if remainder is 1/2/4/6/8/0, auspicious. If both Taras excellent, 3 points; if one auspicious and one inauspicious, 1.5; if both inauspicious, 0.
VIVAHA_TARA_KOOTA.applied_rule_logic: calcTara: count both directions mod 9; position 3/5/7 inauspicious (matches docs, plus remainder 0 = auspicious here).

VIVAHA_YONI_KOOTA.label: Yoni Koota (4 points)
VIVAHA_YONI_KOOTA.english_translation: 14 yonis across 28 nakshatras (Abhijita included): Horse (Ashwini/Shatabhisha), She-buffalo (Swati/Hasta), Lion (Dhanishtha/Poorvabhadrapada), Elephant (Bharani/Revati), Ram (Pushya/Krittika), Monkey (Shravana/Poorvashadha), Mongoose (Uttarashadha/Abhijita), Serpent (Mrigashira/Rohini), Deer (Jyeshtha/Anuradha), Dog (Moola/Ardra), Tom-cat (Punarvasu/Ashlesha), Rat (Magha/Poorvaphalguni), Leopard (Vishakha/Chitra), Cow (Uttaraphalguni/Uttarabhadrapada). Mahabair (extreme enmity) between Horse-Buffalo, Lion-Elephant, Ram-Monkey, Mongoose-Serpent, Deer-Dog, Cat-Mouse, Leopard-Cow. Gunas: Mahabair 0, Bair 1, neutrality 2, Mitrata 3, Ati-mitrata 4.
VIVAHA_YONI_KOOTA.applied_rule_logic: calcYoni via the 14x14 compatibility matrix keyed on nakshatra yoni pairs; marriage rejected on Mahabair pairs unless Vashya is friendly.

VIVAHA_GRAHA_MAITRI_KOOTA.label: Graha Maitri Koota (5 points)
VIVAHA_GRAHA_MAITRI_KOOTA.english_translation: Natural (Naisargika) friendship of the planetary lords of the Janama Rashis. If the lords are the same or friends, 5 gunas; one friend and one neutral, 4; both neutral, 3; one friend and one enemy, 2; one neutral and one enemy, 0. Natural friendship matrix: Sun-Moon-Mars-Jupiter are mutual friends, etc.
VIVAHA_GRAHA_MAITRI_KOOTA.applied_rule_logic: calcMaitri from GRAHA_MAITRI_SCORES lookup on RASHI_LORDS of the two moon signs.

VIVAHA_GANA_KOOTA.label: Gana Koota (6 points)
VIVAHA_GANA_KOOTA.english_translation: Rakshasa (demon) ganas: Magha, Ashlesha, Dhanishtha, Jyeshtha, Moola, Shatabhisha, Kritika, Chitra, Vishakha. Manushya (man) ganas: Poorvaphalguni, Poorvashadha, Poorvabhadrapada, Uttaraphalguni, Uttarashadha, Uttarabhadrapada, Rohini, Bharani, Ardra. Deva (god) ganas: Anuradha, Punarvasu, Mrigashira, Shravana, Revati, Swati, Hasta, Ashwini, Pushya. Same gana gives excessive love; Deva-Manushya gives average love; Rakshasa-Manushya gives death; Deva-Rakshasa gives quarrels. A Rakshasa native should be wedded to a Rakshasa native. 6 points allotted.
VIVAHA_GANA_KOOTA.applied_rule_logic: calcGana from NAKSHATRA_GANA: identical=6, Deva-Manushya=5 (groom Deva), Manushya-Deva=6 per one reading, Deva-Rakshasa=1, Manushya-Rakshasa=0.

VIVAHA_BHAKOOTA_KOOTA.label: Bhakoota Koota (7 points)
VIVAHA_BHAKOOTA_KOOTA.english_translation: If the Janama Rashis are mutually in the 6th and 8th house, it is the giver of death; if in the 9th and 5th, loss of progeny; if in the 2nd and 12th, poverty; happiness in other places. The 7th-house pair Capricorn-Cancer and Leo-Aquarius are mutual enemies. Five removals of Dusta Bhakoota: (1) same lord of the Janama Rashis; (2) friendship between the Rashi lords; (3) Navamsha lords friendly and strong; (4) excellent Tara of both; (5) bride's rashi is the Vashya of the groom's rashi - in all five, favorable Nadi is necessary. Shubha Bhakoota (3rd, 11th, 4th, 10th) destroys planet-enmity doshas.
VIVAHA_BHAKOOTA_KOOTA.applied_rule_logic: calcBhakoot: score 7 for favorable offsets, 0 for 6/8, 5/9, 2/12 unless a classical parihara (Rashi-lord friendship/identity) cancels.

VIVAHA_NADI_KOOTA.label: Nadi Koota (8 points)
VIVAHA_NADI_KOOTA.english_translation: Adi Nadi: Jyeshtha, Moola, Ardra, Punarvasu, Uttaraphalguni, Hasta, Shatabhisha, Poorvabhadrapada, Ashwini. Madhya Nadi: Pushya, Mrigashira, Chitra, Anuradha, Bharani, Dhanishtha, Poorvashadha, Poorvaphalguni, Uttarabhadrapada. Antya Nadi: Swati, Vishakha, Kritika, Rohini, Ashlesha, Magha, Uttarashadha, Shravana, Revati. Same-Nadi marriage is inauspicious; Madhya-Madhya is certainly death-giving. Nadi relates to health, longevity and happiness of issues. 8 points allotted. If there is Nadi Dosha, marriage should be altogether rejected.
VIVAHA_NADI_KOOTA.applied_rule_logic: calcNadi from NAKSHATRA_NADI: different nadi = 8 points; same nadi = 0 unless a classical parihara cancels.

VIVAHA_NADI_DOSHA_PARIHARA.label: Nadi Dosha removals (pariharas)
VIVAHA_NADI_DOSHA_PARIHARA.english_translation: If the Janama Rashis are the same and the nakshatras different, or the nakshatras are the same and the rashis different, there is no Nadi (or Gana) dosha. If the nakshatras are the same but the quarters different, it is also auspicious. The nakshatra of the bridegroom should be first in serial order; if the male's nakshatra is second to the female's it is not auspicious (Gargacharya).
VIVAHA_NADI_DOSHA_PARIHARA.applied_rule_logic: Parihara cancellation for Nadi: same-rashi/diff-nakshatra, same-nakshatra/diff-rashi, same-nakshatra/diff-pada, or Rashi-lord friendship - all restore the 8 points.

VIVAHA_MARRIAGE_NAKSHATRAS.label: Marriage nakshatras, tithis, days and Abhijita
VIVAHA_MARRIAGE_NAKSHATRAS.english_translation: Marriage samskara is auspicious in the Vedha-rahita (without Vedha) nakshatras of Mrigashira, Hasta, Moola, Anuradha, Magha, Rohini, Revati, Uttaraphalguni, Uttarashadha, Uttarabhadrapada and Swati; on all tithis except the Rikta tithis and Amavasya; and on auspicious days (Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday). The 4th quarter of Uttarashadha plus the first 1/15th part of Shravana is the Abhijita nakshatra (not a separate one).
VIVAHA_MARRIAGE_NAKSHATRAS.applied_rule_logic: Day-scan filters: allowedNakshatras (11 stars incl. Moola - note corpus copy omits Moola, verified source includes it), allowedTithis excluding Rikta/Amavasya, allowedVaras Mon/Wed/Thu/Fri.

JAMITRA_DOSHA_ACTIVE.label: Jamitra Dosha (7th sign / 55th navamsha affliction)
JAMITRA_DOSHA_ACTIVE.english_translation: If any planet is situated in the 7th sign from the Ascendant or from the Moon, it causes the dosha named Jamitra; the marriage samskara is not auspicious. It is also caused by a planet situated in the 55th navamsha from the Ascendant or Moon (extremely inauspicious). Removal: if the planet in the 7th sign receives benefic aspect; or if the Moon is exalted, own sign, friend's sign, or in benefic shadvarga; per Martanda Vallabha no Jamitra if Sun occupies 3/6/11. Per Sheeghrabodha, Jamitra by Moon/Mercury/Jupiter/Venus is auspicious, by Sun/Mars/Saturn/Rahu inauspicious.
JAMITRA_DOSHA_ACTIVE.applied_rule_logic: Hard marriage blocker when a malefic (or any planet per the primary reading) sits in the 7th rashi from muhurta lagna or Moon; removal via benefic aspect / strong Moon / Sun in 3-6-11.

PATA_DOSHA_ACTIVE.label: Paata Dosha (Mahapata / severe Nitya Yoga)
PATA_DOSHA_ACTIVE.english_translation: The nakshatra (at the time of marriage) which is at the end of the yogas of Harshana, Vaidhriti, Sadhya, Vyatipaata, Ganda and Shoola is affected by Paata Dosha and rejected as inauspicious for marriage. Narada and Vashishtha: counting from the Sun's nakshatra to Ashlesha, Magha, Anuradha, Chitra, Shravana and Revati, the nakshatras at those numbers from Ashwini are affected (e.g., Sun in Hasta gives Bharani, Mrigashira, Magha, Swati, Shatabhisha, Poorvabhadrapada).
PATA_DOSHA_ACTIVE.applied_rule_logic: Hard marriage blocker when the day's Nitya Yoga is one of the six Paata yogas (Harshana, Vaidhriti, Sadhya, Vyatipata, Ganda, Shoola), plus the Narada/Vashishtha nakshatra-counting variant.

EKARGALA_DOSHA_ACTIVE.label: Ekargala (Khaijoor) Dosha
EKARGALA_DOSHA_ACTIVE.english_translation: On a day with an inauspicious yoga (Vyaghaata, Ganda, Vyatipaata, Shoola, Vishakambha, Vaidhriti, Vajra, Parigha or Atiganda), if the Moon is situated in an odd-numbered nakshatra from the Sun's nakshatra, the dosha named 'Khaijoor' occurs, unacceptable for the marriage samskara (all 28 nakshatras counted incl. Abhijita; per Narada, Abhijita is not counted - Naradiya Samhita ch.7 sl.5-7). Khaijoor = Ekargala. Also Upagraha Dosha: Moon in nakshatras numbered 5/8/10/14/7/19/15/18/21/22/23/24/25 from the Sun's star.
EKARGALA_DOSHA_ACTIVE.applied_rule_logic: Hard marriage blocker when the Moon occupies an odd-count nakshatra from the Sun's nakshatra on a bad-yoga day (docs' (Sun+Moon)%27 formula is WRONG; use Sun->Moon nakshatra count parity).

VIVAHA_DOSHA_REMOVAL_SUN_MOON_LAGNA.label: Removal of Ekargala/Upagraha/Paata/Latta/Jamitra/Kartari/Udaya/Asta
VIVAHA_DOSHA_REMOVAL_SUN_MOON_LAGNA.english_translation: If the Sun and the Moon, being endowed with strength, are posited in the Lagna (Ascendant) of the auspicious deed, then the doshas of Ekargala, Upagraha, Paata, Latta, Jamitra, Kartari, Udaya (rising) and Asta (combustion) are destroyed just as darkness is destroyed by the rising of the Sun.
VIVAHA_DOSHA_REMOVAL_SUN_MOON_LAGNA.applied_rule_logic: Universal marriage removal: strong Sun + Moon in the muhurta lagna cancels the four major doshas (Ekargala, Upagraha, Paata, Latta, Jamitra).

VIVAHA_DOSHA_MASTER_21.label: Master list of marriage doshas to avoid
VIVAHA_DOSHA_MASTER_21.english_translation: Doshas to be avoided in the marriage samskara: Utpaata, Mahapaata, Dagdha Tithi, evil combinations like Vyatipaata, combustion of Moon/Jupiter/Venus, Tithi Kshaya, Tithi Vriddhi, Gandanta, Bhadra, Sankranti day, combustion of Ascendant Lord and Navamsha Lord, Ascendant/Navamsha/Moon lords in 6/8 houses, malefic shadvarga, Chandrayudha, Khaijoor, Dasha Yoga, Jamitra, Latta, Vedha (Sapta and Pancha Shalaka), Baana, Paapa Kartari, Dusta yoga from Tithi/Nakshatra/Day, Ardha Yaama, Kulika, etc.
VIVAHA_DOSHA_MASTER_21.applied_rule_logic: Documentation source for the full 21-dosha scope in marriage_rules.json. Engine implements the 4 major doshas (Latta, Jamitra, Paata, Ekargala) + the Sun/Moon-in-Lagna removal; the rest are recorded as provenance notes.
